title: Safety Project
concept: Build a contract-heavy library from scratch — applying everything from L4: requires, ensures, invariants, verification, and safe abstractions.
why: Theory becomes skill through practice. This project integrates all safety concepts into a real, working library you can use and extend.
tips: Start with the invariants — they define what 'valid' means for your type
Write contracts BEFORE implementing methods — they guide the implementation
Test contract violations explicitly — verify that bad inputs are caught
Use Z3 to prove what you can, property-test what you can't
common_mistakes: Implementing without contracts first — you'll miss edge cases
Making contracts too weak — 'ensures: true' is useless
Forgetting to test contract violations — you need to know your safety net works
